facts.fact: Sonatel (Orange Business Sénégal) launched the first AWS Wavelength zone in West Africa inside Sonatel's data centre in Senegal, with Orange Business Sénégal selling AWS cloud services to outside customers; pilot customers (CTISN, Swarmio) tested it first.

note: No owner, tier or state-hosting fact: the document gives no ownership status, tier rating, or government systems hosted (CTISN is a microfinance IT centre).
